name: Ibrahim Athar
real_life_parallel: Ibrahim Athar — chief IC-814 hijacker; brother of Masood Azhar

biography.background: Chief hijacker of Indian Airlines Flight 814 (December 1999). Brother of Masood Azhar (JeM founder, released in exchange). Core Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) operational figure.
biography.family_connection: Masood Azhar's brother; JeM as family enterprise
biography.hijacking_role: Leader of hijacking team; negotiated with Indian government; demanded Masood Azhar release
biography.post_release: Operated within JeM; remained in Pakistan; never prosecuted
biography.film_1_role: IC-814 hijacking leader; Masood Azhar's brother
